entries.en: to scatter, to sow; to spread (about)
to scatter out, to spread open/apart
to scatter by throwing, to cast and strew about
entries.notes: 汉字「擲」处声调标记污损难辨（T99）；字面与西语 esparcir arrojando「掷撒」互证尚清

entries.en: (of hair) to bristle, stand loose; to be disheveled
(of a hen) to ruffle its feathers, to bristle up
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:霹/雞]并伴污损（T99），西语后半句（col glypho al humbo）难辨读；据 espelucarse la gallina 释「（鸡）蓬炸羽毛」

entries.en: to begin to ruffle its feathers, to bristle up
entries.notes: 多处声调标记污损（T99）；「起來」与西语互证尚清，尾音写 iog 义未详

entries.en: a clear mirror to look at oneself in
to stop, halt; to wait, stay
entries.notes: 西语栏标记[残]（原件残损），据汉字「停」与音写 tĕng 释「停驻、等候」

entries.zh: 守候、停留等候（字栏存疑）
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:听/吥]而义未定；据音写 tĕng…háu 与西语 esperar 释「守候、停留等候」

entries.en: to wait upon, to watch for; to lie in wait
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:侗/伺]，音写 sū 支持「伺」；另有声调标记污损（T99）
汉字栏标记[疑:等/芋]，音写 teng 支持「等」

entries.en: slow, tardy; to delay, take one's time
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:謾/慢]，旁注 despacio（徐缓）支持「慢」义

entries.zh: 期、期望；预期（约定时日以待）
entries.en: to hope for, expect; to await a set time
entries.notes: 音写后段「atminin」污损难辨（T99），据汉字「期」释「期望、预期」
汉字「側」与西语 esperar 语义不合，音写 lada 疑为借词，两处声调标记污损（T99），无法定夺

entries.en: to look/hope for, to await expecting succor
to put off to another time, postpone; to delay/keep
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:罟/留]，音写 lāu、liū 与「留」相合，释「留待、改期」

entries.en: to long for, to await eagerly
entries.notes: 汉字栏标记[疑:巢/果]而义不合；音写 quyâ（kiâ）近「企」，据西语「怀着渴望等待」释「企望、切盼」
